data.text:
A massive fire broke out early this morning at a building in Guizo, Mandaue City, Cebu, Philippines.

The woman showed extraordinary courage and remained calm, refusing to leave anyone behind. She even prioritized rescuing her dogs despite the intensity of the fire. Residents and responding firefighters safely caught the dog she dropped, and the woman herself was rescued with the help of a ladder.

📹 Ivy Baya
